The test image shows a severely desiccated, dried-out, brown/tan mango leaf that is completely withered and curled. The entire leaf has died and dried up, with the petiole still attached. This is consistent with Die_Back disease, where shoot tips and leaves die and desiccate from the tip backward.

Now let me view one reference image from Die_Back to confirm.

The Die_Back reference image is a near-perfect match: a completely desiccated, brown, curled/shriveled mango leaf with similar shape, coloration, and degree of necrosis. Both images show total leaf death with the same dried, twisted, uniformly brown appearance characteristic of Die_Back.
